title: George W. Erving to James Madison, Madrid, 24 Mar 1807, private No. 21 'in the Cypher of the Legation' (Pinckney's code), Founders Madison/02-13-02-0559

documents.shelfmark: NARA RG 59 DD Spain vol. 10 = M31 reel 12 frames 0283-0286 (RC1); LoC Madison Papers mjm014714 (RC2 duplicate)

plaintext.source: Madison's interlinear decode on RC1, printed in PJM-SS 13:529-31 (Founders 02-13-02-0559) with holes and [sic]s; the editors say the key was not found.

transcription.source: NARA M31 reel 12 frames 0284-0286 (RC1, with Madison's decode) collated with LoC mjm014714 images 0604-0607 (RC2)
transcription.notes: Count made by splitting the dotted runs of erving_groups.txt on '.'; docs/_check_profile.py --measure treats each dotted run as one token (90 runs), so the count is not tool-measured. NOTES: some line alignments of the opening paragraph are approximate; the groups at the holes were checked on both copies.

system.summary: Numerical word-and-syllable code of the Madrid legation (Pinckney's code; the = 1651, of = 133), groups joined by dots.
system.sibling_key: Pinckney's own despatches in the same code (M31 reel 7 frames 0346-0352 with Wagner's decode on 0348; reel 8 frames 0083-0084) supplied pairs; used.
system.notes: distinct_symbols counts the letter's groups; no full key rebuilt (NOTES 'Not done').

prior_solution.where: Madison's contemporary interlinear decode on RC1, printed by the Madison editors (PJM-SS 13:529-31, Founders 02-13-02-0559) with its holes.

conditions.human_role: Project-level: set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5 and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Fetched RC1 (NARA M31 reel 12 frames 0283-0286) and RC2 (LoC tile URLs for mjm014714).
Transcribed the groups with Madison's interlinear readings into erving_groups.txt and collated the holes on both copies.
Read pairs from Pinckney's decoded despatches in the same code (reel 7 frames 0346-0352, reel 8 0083-0084): 69 in, 1515 late, 1578 that, 1583 ter.
Closed the printed holes: in the scale, Hanover (x5), see that he was more so, Gibraltar, been lately doing; Madison's slips identified.
Checked sp[eak] (1212 = sp): the rest of the word is missing in both copies, so the loss is Erving's own.

outcome.fraction_read_source: NOTES Results: every hole in Madison's printed decode closed; no token-level reading file
outcome.notes: Read at the time by Madison; this project closed the holes in the printed text (a small completion). The only loss is Erving's dropped -eak after 1212, missing in both copies. No full Pinckney key was rebuilt (key: partial). Model id from commit trailers (Claude Opus 5, 1M context); the files were committed inside commits about other targets.
